Subject: Everholt Auto Care - Referral Required

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the submission on Everholt Auto Care. I've reviewed the information and have a complete package to work with.

This account requires referral to our senior underwriting team for two reasons:
1. Auto care/repair facilities need additional review under our guidelines
2. The five-year loss history exceeds $250K

Before I can move this forward, I need to answer a few questions:
- What specific operations does Everholt perform (oil changes, body work, mechanical repairs)?
- Can you provide details on the loss history - what types of claims and any corrective actions taken?
- Are there any specialized services or equipment involved?

Once I have these answers, I'll escalate for consideration. If our appetite doesn't align, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty auto program.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
